description.text: Build and own our internal developer platform on Kubernetes. Write Go operators and controllers (kubebuilder). GitOps with ArgoCD, Terraform, Helm, Vault. Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. Must have strong experience in Java. 8+ years. Backstage IDP.

Lead SAP Commerce (Hybris) D2C rollouts and go-live. Own solution design with stakeholders. Headless migration to commercetools and Contentstack CMS. GraphQL integrations. Agile, JIRA. 10+ years e-commerce. QA and UAT coordination. Checkout and payment gateway flows.
Spring Boot microservices for checkout business logic, React frontend, full stack. Kubernetes, AWS, Python. 7-12 years.

Own test strategy and STLC for our ecommerce storefront. UAT, regression testing, defect management. Agile scrum with JIRA. Must have hands-on Selenium automation framework experience and ISTQB certification is mandatory. 12-18 years.
